description_en: Queries data sensitivity levels in Data Security Guard
description_zh: 调用QuerySensLevel接口，查询在数据保护伞定义的敏感数据等级
name: QuerySensLevel

parameters.help_en: The ID of the template defined by Data Security Guard. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2743948.html operation to query the ID
parameters.help_zh: 数据保护伞定义的模板ID。可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2743948.html接口获取
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. To obtain the tenant ID, perform the following steps: Log on to the [DataWorks console](https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console). Find your workspace and go to the DataStudio page. On the DataStudio page, click the logon username in the upper-right corner and click User Info in the Menu section
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID。您可登录[DataWorks控制台](https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入数据开发（DataStudio）页面，单击右上方当前登录用户名称，选择菜单 > 用户信息，获取租户ID
parameters.name: tenant_id
